card.name: Linking words before meals or reference terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, to, for, based) right after a dose or population phrase, usually just before "meals", "food" or "gestational age".

modes.label: With/to before meals
modes.description: The word "with" or "to" after dosing frequency or "without regard", just before meals or food.

modes.label: For before gestational age
modes.description: The word "for" or "appropriate for" after birth weight, leading into "gestational age".
modes.example: 1 year of age with low birth weight<< for>> gestational age 0.45
